persona: 가장 가벼운 비활성 기체의 나라. 무엇과도 섞이지 않는 귀족인데, 늘 땅에서 조금 떠 있다. 지구가 아니라 햇빛 속에서 먼저 발견됐다 — 일식 때 태양 가장자리의 노란 선 하나로.

ko: 가장 가벼운 비활성 기체 — 무엇과도 반응하지 않는 고고함
떠오름 — 풍선 · 비행선 · 땅에서 살짝 뜬 발끝
일식 때 햇빛 속 노란 분광선으로 처음 찾았다
방전관의 옅은 복숭앗빛 · 극저온 초유체가 벽을 타고 오른다
traits.en: the lightest noble gas: aloof and never reacting with anything, yet always lifting — balloons, airships, feet hovering just above the ground; first found not on Earth but in sunlight, as a single golden spectral line at the edge of an eclipsed sun; a gas-discharge tube glowing soft peach-pink; chilled near absolute zero it becomes a superfluid that creeps up the walls of its glass

palette.en: pale peach-pink discharge glow, cloud white, high-altitude sky blue, a thin golden spectral line

fantasy.ko: 해가 사라진 날의 나라 — 산꼭대기 일식 신전, 프리즘이 가른 햇빛의 금빛 선, 저절로 떠오르는 복숭앗빛 등불
fantasy.en: a kingdom built for the day the sun goes dark: a mountaintop eclipse temple above the clouds, great crystal prisms splitting the last sunlight into a spectrum with one thin golden line, peach-pink lanterns that rise on their own and drift into the darkened sky

scenes.en: in a mountaintop eclipse temple as the sun goes dark
in a hall of great crystal prisms casting spectra on the floor
among peach-pink lanterns rising by themselves into the dusk

steampunk.ko: 1868 일식 원정대 — 산 위 관측 천막, 태양을 겨눈 황동 망원경 · 분광기, 옅은 복숭앗빛 방전관 실험대
steampunk.en: around 1868, an eclipse expedition camp on a high plateau: canvas observing tents, a brass telescope and spectroscope aimed at the darkened sun, glass gas-discharge tubes glowing peach-pink on a field bench, tethered observation balloons

scenes.en: at the eclipse expedition's canvas observing tents
beside a brass telescope and spectroscope aimed at the sun
at a field bench of glowing peach-pink gas-discharge tubes

mecha.ko: 2200 달 헬륨-3 채굴 기지 — 레골리스 수확기, 핵융합 돔, 검은 하늘의 지구
mecha.en: year 2200, a lunar helium-3 mining colony: regolith harvesters crawling over grey dunes, fusion-reactor domes glowing peach-pink, the blue Earth hanging in a black sky

scenes.en: on grey regolith dunes with harvesters crawling behind
under a fusion-reactor dome glowing soft peach-pink
at the colony's edge as Earth rises over the horizon

mecha.design: cloud-white and pale peach armor with rounded balloon-like pauldrons, ring units hovering weightless around her waist and wrists, soft peach-pink discharge glow lines, a clear visor ring, frost-white superfluid shimmer at the joints, heels that never quite touch the ground; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown

hold.en: a small round glow of peach-pink gas floating just above her open palm

look.why: 방전관의 복숭앗빛이 머리 · 눈. 떠오르는 귀족 → 가늘고 풍만, 물속처럼 떠오르는 긴 웨이브. 고고하지만 부드러운 인상 — 귀여움 · 큰 눈을 피했다(화풍 v3, 2026-11-02)

persona: 모래와 유리와 생각하는 돌의 나라. 땅껍질에서 산소 다음으로 많은, 가장 흔하고 참을성 있는 원소 — 바위와 모래로 수억 년을 버티다 이제는 칩이 되어 생각한다.

ko: 모래 · 석영 · 녹인 유리
결정 — 무지갯빛 웨이퍼 광택의 청회색
회로 — 금선이 새겨진 칩, 생각하는 돌
가장 흔하고 참을성 있는 땅의 원소
traits.en: silicon: beach sand and desert quartz, molten glass glowing orange in the furnace, blue-grey metallic crystal with a rainbow silicon-wafer sheen, gold circuit traces etched into chips; the most patient element of the earth's crust, stone that learned to think

palette.en: wafer blue-grey with a rainbow sheen, clear quartz, desert sand, molten-glass orange, circuit gold

fantasy.ko: 노래하는 모래의 사막 — 유리 불는 장인의 도시, 번개가 녹인 유리 탑, 석영 동굴
fantasy.en: a desert of singing sands: a glassblowers' city of furnaces and coloured glass domes, towers of lightning-fused glass rising from the dunes, a cave of giant clear quartz crystals

scenes.en: on wind-carved singing dunes under a hard blue sky
in the glassblowers' street of glowing furnaces
in a cave of giant clear quartz crystals

steampunk.ko: 1880 유리 공장과 렌즈 깎는 방 — 녹인 유리 화로, 쇠와 유리판의 수정궁 온실
steampunk.en: around 1880, a great glassworks and a lens-grinding hall: furnaces of molten glass, glassblowers' pipes, telescope lenses on brass grinding wheels, an iron-and-glass crystal-palace conservatory next door

scenes.en: in the furnace hall of a great glassworks
in a lens-grinding room of brass wheels and polished glass
inside an iron-and-glass crystal-palace conservatory

mecha.ko: 2200 화성 태양광 유리 사막 — 끝없는 실리콘 태양판 들판, 모래를 녹여 지은 유리 아콜로지
mecha.en: year 2200, a Martian dune sea paved with endless silicon solar fields, a glass arcology fused from the red sand itself, data-light pulsing through its transparent walls

scenes.en: among endless silicon solar fields on a red dune sea
inside a glass arcology fused from red sand
in a transparent data core of stacked wafers

mecha.design: blue-grey crystalline armor plates with a rainbow silicon-wafer sheen, gold circuit traces etched across the plates, a clear quartz visor, a back unit of fanned solar-panel wings, pale cyan data-light lines; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown

hold.en: a palm-sized raw quartz crystal whose one end is cut and polished into a gleaming silicon chip

look.why: 웨이퍼의 무지갯빛 청회색이 머리, 강철빛 눈. 참을성 있는 땅 → 탄탄하고 굴곡진 몸, 무표정한 인상 · 맨얼굴

persona: 화산과 지옥불의 나라. 분화구에 노란 결정으로 피어나고, 밤이면 푸른 불꽃으로 탄다. 화약의 한 몫, 고무를 질기게 하는 원소 — 냄새부터 위험하다.

ko: 분화구의 레몬빛 노란 결정
밤에 푸르게 타는 불꽃 · 매캐한 노란 연기
유황과 지옥불의 전설 · 화약의 한 몫
검은 현무암 · 고무를 질기게
traits.en: sulfur: bright lemon-yellow crystals blooming at volcanic vents, burning at night with an eerie electric-blue flame, choking yellow fumes, brimstone-and-hellfire legend, one third of black gunpowder, the toughness of vulcanized black rubber, black basalt underfoot

palette.en: sulfur yellow, eerie blue flame, volcanic basalt black, ember red

fantasy.ko: 화산 왕국 — 유황 껍질의 분화구 호수, 밤 비탈의 푸른 불, 현무암 궁전
fantasy.en: a volcano kingdom: a turquoise crater lake crusted with yellow sulfur, rivers of eerie blue flame running down the slopes at night, a basalt-columned palace carved into the caldera wall

scenes.en: by a turquoise crater lake crusted with yellow sulfur
on a night slope where blue flames run like rivers
in a hall of black basalt columns inside the caldera

steampunk.ko: 1850 유황 광산과 화약 공장 — 노란 광석 가마, 놋쇠 띠 화약통, 고무 가황 공장
steampunk.en: around 1850, a sulfur mine and a gunpowder mill: heaps of yellow ore burning in kilns, brass-bound powder kegs in a magazine, a vulcanizing works for rubber with steaming presses

scenes.en: beside heaps of yellow ore smouldering in kilns
in a gunpowder magazine of brass-bound kegs
in a vulcanizing works of steaming rubber presses

mecha.ko: 2200 이오 식민지 — 목성의 화산 위성, 유황 분출 기둥, 하늘을 채운 목성
mecha.en: year 2200, a colony on Io, Jupiter's volcanic moon: sulfur plumes erupting hundreds of kilometres high, a yellow-orange cratered plain, Jupiter filling the sky

scenes.en: before a towering sulfur plume on Io
on a yellow-orange cratered plain under Jupiter
at a colony outpost built over a volcanic vent

mecha.design: volcanic black basalt armor with bright sulfur-yellow crystal growths at the joints, eerie blue-flame vents at shoulders and heels, ember-red underglow along the seams, a back unit shaped like a smoking volcanic vent; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown

hold.en: a lump of bright yellow sulfur crystal burning with a small blue flame

look.why: 현무암 검정에 유황 노랑 끝이 머리, 푸른 불꽃 눈. 지옥불의 유혹 → 풍만한 몸, 매혹적인 인상 · 스모키 화장. 나트륨의 레몬빛 머리와 겹치지 않게 노랑은 끝에만

persona: 독과 깨끗함의 나라. 구름이면 맹독의 연둣빛 안개, 한 방울이면 물을 지키는 소독약. 바다 소금의 다른 반쪽 — 표백한 흰빛처럼 차갑고 단정하다.

ko: 연둣빛 노란 기체 — 구름이면 독, 한 방울이면 깨끗함
수영장의 맑음 · 표백한 흰 천 · 코를 찌르는 깨끗한 냄새
바다 소금의 다른 반쪽
소독 · 표백 · 정화
traits.en: chlorine: a pale yellow-green gas that is poison in a cloud and cleanliness in a drop — the clarity of a swimming pool, bleached white linen snapping in the wind, the sharp clean smell; the other half of sea salt; it disinfects, bleaches and purifies

palette.en: chlorine yellow-green, bleach white, pool aqua, hazard black

fantasy.ko: 정화의 나라 — 밝은 바닷가 흰 목욕 신전, 바람에 마르는 표백 천의 줄, 성벽 너머 금지된 연둣빛 안개 늪
fantasy.en: a kingdom of cleansing: white salt-stone bathhouse temples by a bright sea, rows of bleached linen drying in the wind on the cliffs, and beyond the walls a forbidden marsh of pale yellow-green mist

scenes.en: in a white salt-stone bathhouse temple by the sea
on a cliff where rows of bleached linen dry in the wind
at the wall's edge above a marsh of yellow-green mist

steampunk.ko: 1900 처음 염소로 소독한 상수도와 빅토리아 공중목욕탕 — 타일 수영장, 놋쇠 관 · 계기, 연둣빛 기체 유리병
steampunk.en: around 1900, the first chlorinated city waterworks beside a Victorian public bath: tiled swimming pools under iron roofs, brass pipes and pressure gauges, glass carboys of yellow-green gas

scenes.en: in a waterworks dosing room of brass pipes and gauges
beside a tiled Victorian swimming bath under an iron roof
in a bleachworks of steaming vats and white sheets

mecha.ko: 2200 바다 정수 거대 구조물 — 티 없이 소독된 흰 도시, 위험 줄무늬, 연둣빛 기체 탱크
mecha.en: year 2200, an ocean purification megastructure: a spotless sanitized white city on stilts over the sea, hazard-striped decks, banks of translucent yellow-green gas tanks

scenes.en: on a hazard-striped purification deck over the sea
among banks of glowing yellow-green gas tanks
beside an impossibly clear purified water basin

mecha.design: bleach-white armor with translucent yellow-green gas chambers set into the plates, hazard-black stripe trim, a filter-mask visor that leaves her face visible, pool-aqua glow lines; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown

hold.en: a small sealed glass ampoule of swirling yellow-green gas

look.why: 연둣빛 기체가 머리 · 눈. 차갑고 단정한 소독 → 가는 몸, 중성적인 인상 · 짙은 입술. 표백한 흰빛의 도자기 피부

persona: 뼈와 진주와 대리석의 나라. 살아 있는 것이 몸을 세울 때 쓰는 원소 — 뼈와 이, 조개와 진주, 그리고 그들이 쌓여 생긴 석회암 절벽과 흰 대리석 조각상. 천천히, 단단하게.

ko: 살아 있는 것이 몸을 세우는 원소 — 뼈 · 이 · 조개
진주의 무지갯빛 · 흰 대리석 조각상
석회암 절벽 · 만 년 동안 자라는 종유석
희고 단단하고 참을성 있게
traits.en: calcium: the element living things build their bodies with — bone and teeth, seashells and pearls with a pink-and-silver nacre sheen; limestone cliffs laid down by countless shells, white marble statues, chalk, stalactites dripping for ten thousand years; pale, strong and patient

palette.en: pearl white, bone ivory, marble grey veining, coral pink, limestone cream

fantasy.ko: 흰 석회암 절벽과 산호초의 바다 왕국 — 조각상의 대리석 신전, 진주 캐는 석호, 종유석 동굴 성당
fantasy.en: a sea kingdom of white limestone cliffs and coral reefs: a marble temple of statues above the waves, a pearl divers' lagoon, a cathedral cave of stalactites and still pools

scenes.en: in a marble temple of statues above the sea
at a pearl divers' lagoon of clear turquoise water
in a cathedral cave of stalactites and still pools

steampunk.ko: 1870 대리석 채석장과 조각가의 작업실 — 흰 대리석 덩어리, 석고 틀, 유리 지붕 아래 고래 뼈대가 걸린 자연사 박물관
steampunk.en: around 1870, a white-marble quarry and a sculptor's atelier beside a Victorian natural-history museum: marble blocks and plaster casts, a whale skeleton hung under a glass roof, cabinets of shells and coral

scenes.en: in a terraced white-marble quarry
in a sculptor's atelier of marble blocks and plaster casts
under a whale skeleton in a glass-roofed museum hall

mecha.ko: 2200 생체 칼슘으로 자란 산호초 아콜로지 — 뼈처럼 흰 유기 구조물, 진주빛 돔
mecha.en: year 2200, a reef arcology grown from bio-engineered calcium: bone-white organic towers like coral and vertebrae, pearl-sheened domes, a turquoise sea around it

scenes.en: among bone-white coral-grown towers
under a pearl-sheened dome
in a corridor ribbed like a spine

mecha.design: bone-ivory armor grown like coral and shell — ribbed seashell pauldrons, nacre-pearl panels with a pink-and-silver sheen, marble-grey veining across the plates, a spine-like segmented back unit; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown

hold.en: a single large lustrous pearl resting in an open shell

look.why: 진주빛 흰 머리, 산호빛 눈. 조각상 → 늘씬하고 조각 같은 몸, 성숙한 인상 · 입가 점

persona: 사람이 처음 녹인 금속의 나라. 청동기를 열었고, 지금은 모든 전선 속을 흐르며 세상을 잇는다. 비를 맞으면 청록 녹청을 입는 따뜻하고 부지런한 붉은 금속.

ko: 사람이 처음 녹인 금속 — 청동기의 칼과 종
전선 — 세상을 잇는 붉은 금속
비에 젖은 동상의 청록 녹청
따뜻하고 잘 통하는
traits.en: copper: warm rose-red metal, the first metal humans ever smelted — bronze-age blades, shields and temple bells; it carries electricity through every wire in the world; left in the rain it ages to blue-green verdigris like an old statue; warm, conductive and hard-working

palette.en: polished copper red, verdigris teal, bronze brown, electric spark blue

fantasy.ko: 청동기의 섬 왕국 — 구리 광산과 제련로, 청동 종과 방패, 녹청으로 푸르게 변한 신전 돔
fantasy.en: a bronze-age island kingdom: copper mines and smelting furnaces, bronze bells and shields cast in clay moulds, a temple dome weathered blue-green with verdigris

scenes.en: in a smelting yard of clay furnaces and glowing copper
in a bell tower of great bronze bells
under a temple dome weathered blue-green

steampunk.ko: 1885 전기의 구리 시대 — 전선이 웅웅대는 전신국, 거대한 구리선 타래, 거대 동상의 구리 껍질을 두드리는 작업장
steampunk.en: around 1885, the copper age of electricity: a telegraph office humming with wires, giant spools of copper cable, a workshop hammering the copper skin of a colossal statue over wooden forms

scenes.en: in a telegraph office humming with wires
among giant spools of copper cable
in a workshop hammering a colossal statue's copper skin

mecha.ko: 2200 행성 전력망 도시 — 초전도 코일 탑, 하늘을 가로지르는 구리빛 송전선, 푸른 방전
mecha.en: year 2200, a planet-wide power-grid city: superconducting coil towers, copper-gold transmission lines strung across the sky, blue arcs of electricity leaping between spires

scenes.en: among towering superconducting coils
under copper transmission lines strung across the sky
between spires as blue arcs leap across

mecha.design: polished copper-red armor wound with coil patterns like electromagnet windings, verdigris-teal panels at the edges, electric-blue spark lines arcing between pauldron coils, a back unit of two Tesla-coil spires; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown

hold.en: a coil of copper wire with a tiny blue spark jumping across its ends

look.why: 윤낸 구리 머리, 녹청빛 눈. 부지런한 장인 → 굴곡진 몸, 장난기 있는 인상 · 주근깨

persona: 달의 금속의 나라. 어떤 금속보다 밝게 비추는 거울, 은화와 은식기, 괴물을 쫓는 은 탄환, 처음 사진을 맺은 은. 황이 닿는 자리마다 검게 변색한다 — 차갑고 순수하다.

ko: 달의 금속 — 가장 밝은 거울빛
은화 · 은식기 · 괴물을 쫓는 은 탄환
처음 사진을 맺은 은판
황에 닿으면 검게 변색 — 차갑고 순수
traits.en: silver: the moon's metal — the brightest mirror shine of any metal, coins and cutlery, silver bullets against monsters in legend, the silvered plates that held the first photographs; it tarnishes black wherever sulfur touches it; cold, pure and reflective

palette.en: moonlit silver, mirror white, tarnish black, cold blue moonlight

fantasy.ko: 달빛 왕국 — 거울처럼 고요한 은빛 호수, 달의 여신의 은광, 거울의 전당
fantasy.en: a moonlit kingdom: a lake so still it is a silver mirror, the moon goddess's silver mine glittering in the cliffs, a hall of mirrors where moonlight is multiplied endlessly

scenes.en: on the shore of a mirror-still silver lake at night
in a silver mine glittering under moonlight
in a hall of mirrors multiplying the moonlight

steampunk.ko: 1840 은판 사진관과 은세공 가게 — 유리 지붕 촬영실, 은을 입힌 동판, 반짝이는 은 찻그릇
steampunk.en: around 1840, a daguerreotype photographer's glass-roofed studio: silver-plated copper plates, posing chairs and brass head-clamps, fuming boxes; next door a silversmith's shop of gleaming tea services

scenes.en: in a glass-roofed daguerreotype studio
at a bench of silvered plates and brass cameras
in a silversmith's shop of gleaming tea services

mecha.ko: 2200 우주 거울 관측소 — 접히는 거울 꽃잎의 망원경 도시, 차가운 달빛
mecha.en: year 2200, a space mirror observatory: a city of folding mirror petals unfurled like a giant telescope, cold blue moonlight, the stars doubled in every surface

scenes.en: among unfurling mirror petals of a space telescope
on an observation deck reflecting the stars
in orbit with the moon hanging close

mecha.design: mirror-polished silver armor that reflects the scene around her, cold blue moonlight glow lines, patches of black tarnish etched like filigree at the edges, a back unit of folding mirror petals like a space telescope; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown

hold.en: a small round silver hand mirror catching moonlight

look.why: 거울빛 은 머리, 얼음빛 눈. 달의 차가움 → 모래시계 몸, 차가운 인상 · 날 선 아이라인. 수소의 은백 머리와 겹치지 않게 액체 거울빛

persona: 가장 무거운 자연 원소의 나라. 별이 죽을 때 태어나 지구 깊숙이 숨어 있던 힘. 우라늄 유리의 으스스한 초록, 원자로의 푸른 빛 — 장엄하지만 가둬야 하는 원소.

ko: 가장 무거운 자연 원소 — 별의 죽음에서 태어났다
우라늄 유리의 형광 초록 · 원자로 물속의 푸른 빛
느린 붕괴 · 경고의 삼엽 문양
장엄하지만 가둬야 하는 힘
traits.en: uranium: the heaviest natural element, forged in dying stars and hidden deep in the earth; dense and slowly decaying; uranium glass glowing eerie green, the blue Cherenkov glow of a reactor pool, yellowcake powder, the black-and-yellow trefoil of warning; immense power that must be contained

palette.en: uranium-glass green glow, Cherenkov blue, yellowcake yellow, lead grey, hazard black

fantasy.ko: 산 밑 깊은 곳의 묻힌 왕국 — 초록으로 빛나는 수정 광맥 동굴, 납 문 뒤에 잠든 별의 힘, 경고의 고대 룬
fantasy.en: a buried kingdom deep under the mountains: caverns lit by veins of glowing green crystal, a sealed vault where a star-forged power sleeps behind great lead doors, ancient warning runes carved around it

scenes.en: in a cavern lit by glowing green crystal veins
before great lead doors of a sealed vault
in a corridor carved with ancient warning runes

steampunk.ko: 1898 방사능을 찾아낸 오두막 실험실 — 초록으로 빛나는 우라늄 유리 그릇, 흐려진 사진 건판, 역청 광석 자루
steampunk.en: around 1898, a chemist's shed laboratory where radioactivity was discovered: uranium-glass vessels glowing green, fogged photographic plates, a brass electrometer, sacks of black pitchblende ore

scenes.en: in a cluttered shed laboratory of glowing glassware
at a bench of fogged photographic plates and an electrometer
among sacks of black pitchblende ore

mecha.ko: 2200 원자로 요새 — 체렌코프 빛이 도는 냉각 수조, 격납 고리, 경고 삼엽 문양
mecha.en: year 2200, a reactor fortress: a deep cooling pool glowing Cherenkov blue, massive containment rings, hazard trefoils on lead-grey bulkheads

scenes.en: above a deep cooling pool glowing Cherenkov blue
inside massive containment rings
by lead-grey bulkheads marked with warning trefoils

mecha.design: lead-grey heavy armor with glowing uranium-glass green core panels, a ring of Cherenkov-blue light circling her waist like a containment field, yellow-and-black hazard trim, a back reactor unit with cooling fins; dense, armored, contained power; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown

hold.en: a small sealed lead-glass capsule with a softly glowing green core

look.why: 우라늄 유리 초록 머리, 체렌코프 푸른 눈. 가둬 둔 힘 → 탄탄한 몸, 날카로운 인상 · 차가운 미소
